verses.text: Come, let's sing for joy to the LORD! Let's shout out loud to the rock who saves us!
Let's come to him with thanks. Let's praise him with songs!
The LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
He holds the deepest parts of the earth in his hand. The mountain peaks belong to him.
The sea is his, because he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
Come, let's bow down and worship him. Let's kneel in front of the LORD, our Maker.
He is our God. We are the people he takes care of, the sheep in his care. Today, if only you would listen to his voice!
He says, "Do not make your hearts stubborn as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness.
There your ancestors tested me and tried my patience, even though they had seen what I did.
For forty years I was angry with that generation. I said, 'Their hearts always go the wrong way. They do not know my ways.'
So in my anger I made a promise: 'They will never enter my place of rest.'"
